# Introduction

Draugr are aggressive creatures found in Swamps and in Draugr villages, Sunken Crypts and sometimes Mountain towers. They are ancient undead Vikings that have since become bloated in appearance.

## Drops

• Item: Draugr trophy | 0 Star: 10% | 1 Star: 10% | 2 Star: 10%

• Item: Entrails | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

## Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Swamps | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Common spawn point in Draugr villages | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: Common spawn point in Sunken Crypts | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: Multiple spawn points near Swamp structures | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: No

• Type: From Body piles in Swamps, Sunken Crypts or Mountain towers | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Every 6 seconds | Stars: Yes

• Type: Anywhere in Meadows, Black Forests or Plains during foggy nights after defeating The Elder, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Rare | Stars: No

• Type: During "A foul smell from the swamp" event before defeating Bonemass | Limit: 3 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

## Attacks and abilities

Draugr come in two variants: 75% of them are equipped with axes and the other 25% have bows.

### Axe

Does a horizontal slash that extends 2.2 meters and arcs 90 degrees (48 Slash and 15 Tier 0 Chop damage). This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used within 1.6 meters of a player.

### Bow

Nocks an arrow and shoots the player (48 Pierce damage). The arrow travels at 30 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 2–20 degrees. This attack has a 4-second cooldown and can be used within 20 meters of a player.

## Notes

• Entering a Sunken Crypt and leaving Draugr alive there will count towards spawn caps effectively suppressing their spawns in a large area.
• Draugr or Draug - "the undead of Valheim", also called aptrganga or aptrgangr in the Norse literature. Draugr live in their graves, often guarding treasure buried with them in their burial mound.
